reviews.title: Perfectly Practical Pencils
reviews.body: Unbelievably great quality! Had no idea there’d be such a difference between dollar store pencils and these - wow! Never going back as these are worth the price and last WAY longer than the cheap ones. I haven’t had to sharpen the first one I used yet.
reviews.author: Joseph H

reviews.title: Best wood pencil in the market
reviews.body: Nothing like a Ticonderoga pencil. The smell, the appearance, the writing quality. All make these the best wooden pencils I have ever used. They have ruined all other wooden pencils for me lol. Paired with a good sharpener and you can’t go wrong. Have bought additional packs many times over. My kids are also obsessed and have been know to say of other pencils, “this is no Ticonderoga!”lolNot only are they good for writing, practicing printing/cursive, they are also fantastic drawing pencils. The erasers are always good. Nothing worse than using a pencil with an inferior eraser.
reviews.author: Aline
